items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Wells and I and the drummer, and we went over to Oakland

ctx.x: No. No, it wasn't no American. It was Mexican, and they was fighting amongst themselves, I think. I don't know whether it was part of Villa's gang or not. I don't remember now what it was all about. And so we all went...worked out on the beach in...in San Francisco--Canary Cottage. Then, after that, after that contract finished, Lester Mapp that we had started from, opened a big place, and he persuaded Slocum--or Mitchell--with the clarinet and, I think, the piano player and...to go back with him. That kind of…
And that was at Central Avenue and what street?
